items.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
items.en_title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI's Control Room keeps watch over model workloads spread across its research infrastructure, and can halt them fast if a safety issue comes up.

items.title: Your Experts Have Partners. There's HOPE for Keeping Them Together
items.en_title: Your Experts Have Partners. There's HOPE for Keeping Them Together
items.en_oneliner: A higher-order pruning method, HOPE, keeps collaborating experts together when pruning models.

items.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
items.en_title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
items.en_oneliner: With the OpenAI API, Kuken searches 70 years of cooling tower drawings — what once took an engineer nearly an hour now takes 4.5 minutes to find the drawing for a repair.

items.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.en_title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.en_oneliner: CodeRabbit relies on OpenAI models to keep AI-generated code trustworthy, then uses Codex so the same engineering team ships 20 times as much software.

items.title: How VistaPrint helps small businesses get the word out
items.en_title: How VistaPrint helps small businesses get the word out
items.en_oneliner: Owners of small firms getting ready for a product launch or a big event usually settle the goal first and work out the printing later, and VistaPrint shows how signs and branded goods help them put that plan into practice with ChatGPT Ads.

items.title: Portals on Your Runner
items.en_oneliner: Portals, previously available in orbs, now work on your local machine too, so a dev server or website Amp starts locally can be opened straight from the thread.
